# A Fixture Paper on Citations

## Introduction

Paradigms shift when anomalies accumulate \[1\]. Lending follows growth \[2\]. The same shift recurs \[1\].

Several studies agree \[2\], \[3\]. Trust can be measured \[3, p. 40\]. Networks persist \[3, p. 41\].

## Discussion

\[2\] argue that lending policy follows growth.
